messages:
lucy: thinking about a safe 'seed rotation' policy for flag rollouts. goal: rotate seed to rebalance cohorts without surprising customers. what constraints should we enforce?

rahul: must be auditable + reversible. any seed change should create a new config version with an annotation, and we should be able to backfill which users moved.

emily: UX: console should show a "reshuffle impact" preview before commit (small sample + expected change % by geo). customers keep asking if seed changes will cost them extra tokens. show estimated token delta.

fred: infra: large reshuffles can cause cache churn and downstream DB hotkeys. we need a staged rotation: sample -> 1% -> 10% -> full over 24-72h and watch cache miss rate and tail latency.

ops-bot: alert: last seed rotate (flag: new-ui) caused 12% increase in redis miss-rate for 30m on 2025-11-10. reference: incident PLTF-311.

lucy: thanks. so policy draft: 1) seed rotation must be a versioned config change; 2) require dry_run mode for 24h with rollout_exposure metric observed; 3) staged rollout steps with automatic pause on metric anomalies.

rahul: add a constraint: automatic rotation blocked if recent rollout already changed >5% of users in past 7d. we need debounce to avoid oscillation.

emily: console feature: when authoring rotation show a toggle "simulate reshuffle only" that writes a preview record but doesn't flip live traffic. also show 'affected cohorts' chart and an example list of user IDs that would flip.

fred: about implementation: hash function must be platform-stable. we should expose `hash_version` and persist it in ledger. algorithm: `xxh64(user_id || flag_id || seed || hash_version)` to allow controlled upgrades.

lucy: good call. add migration plan for hash_version bumps: dual-hash compare window and canary percent.

console-bot: note: console analytics event 'seed_preview_view' recorded when preview opened.

rahul: telemetry: rollout_exposure metric should be emitted with labels: flag_id, seed, hash_version, cohort_bucket. also add 'reshuffle_delta' gauge: percent of active users who would change inclusion.

emily: UI needs a clear 'rollback' affordance with one-click revert to previous seed + audit entry. critical for oncall.

fred: ops checklist additions:
- run cache warming job for users expected to be majority after rotation
- monitor 95/99p latency + redis miss-rate for 2h post-step
- verify billing-exposure metric vs expected (token/use)

lucy: question: should we allow manual seed input (hex) or restrict to autogenerated values? pros/cons?

rahul: allow manual but gated by role + two-step confirmation + audit log. default to `auto:<deployment_id>:<timestamp>`.

emily: add a console warning: "Manual seed may reshape cohorts. Consider using preview and dry-run." include link to runbook.

fred: small API schema proposal: `{"rollout_pct": number, "seed": string | null, "hash_version": string, "dry_run": boolean}`. dry_run returns `preview_id` with sample diffs endpoint.

lucy: agree. API should return `diff_summary` with `pct_changed_by_geo` and a small `sample_users` array for preview. keep sample size capped (e.g., 10k).

console-bot: created task: PLTF-512 `seed-rotation-preview-api` (assignee: emily).

rahul: tests: add unit for deterministic mapping, end-to-end sim that runs multiple rotations and asserts monotonicity constraints, plus a stress test to measure cache churn.

emily: I'll design the preview UI and show mockups in the design review tomorrow. include token-cost estimates and an explicit checkbox: "I understand reshuffle risk".

lucy: timeline: implement API + ledger persistence (rahul/fred) by next week, UI + preview (emily) + runbook updates (ops) end of sprint. i'll write the RFC and link tasks.

ops-bot: scheduled deploy: config-service v2.1 -> canary 2% at 2026-04-01T09:00Z (PLTF-520).

lucy: nudge: remember to add the chi-square uniformity probe (nightly) and surface an alert if cohorts become skewed after rotation.

fred: will add probe to telemetry plan. thanks all. :rocket:
